verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Capacities' own capture paths: bookmarks are saved as objects and linked to notes, and content can be saved from Twitter or via email. Nothing documents a browser web clipper, full-article capture, or highlight clipping. missing for 10: an official browser extension/clipper, article content capture, highlight clipping, in-depth docs on the bookmark capture flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can clip web pages, articles, and highlights from my browser straight into my notes with an official clipper or capture flow

citations.quote: Bookmark saved as an object and linked to your project notes.
Save content from WhatsApp, Telegram, Twitter, or via email
